stakeholders.name: Miners Association of Nigeria (MAN)
stakeholders.description: National industry association representing miners across Nigeria; advocates for enabling policies, sector development and improved operating environment.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Sector advocacy, industry coordination, membership representation.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Represents mining companies; engages government on policy reforms; supports mining business environment; provides platforms for dialogue between industry, government and communities.
stakeholders.mandate: National industry association representing miners across Nigeria; advocates for enabling policies, sector development and improved operating environment.

stakeholders.name: Women in Mining in Nigeria (WIM)
stakeholders.description: Promote gender inclusion, women’s participation and leadership in Nigeria’s mining sector; provide advocacy, training and empowerment for women in mining.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Supports women miners; conducts training and advocacy; engages policymakers on gender-responsive mining governance; leads national campaigns for women’s representation.
stakeholders.mandate: Promote gender inclusion, women’s participation and leadership in Nigeria’s mining sector; provide advocacy, training and empowerment for women in mining.

stakeholders.name: Nigeria Indigenous Women in Mining and Natural Resources Organisation (NINWINRO)
stakeholders.description: Advance participation and rights of indigenous women involved in mining and natural resource activities.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Supports indigenous women in mining; drives advocacy on rights and inclusion; promotes safe and fair resource practices.
stakeholders.mandate: Advance participation and rights of indigenous women involved in mining and natural resource activities.

stakeholders.name: Nigerian Mining and Geosciences Society (NMGS)
stakeholders.description: Professional body for geoscientists, mining engineers and earth science professionals.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Professional development, technical standards, scientific research.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Promotes geoscience research; publishes journals; organises scientific conferences and training.
stakeholders.mandate: Professional body for geoscientists, mining engineers and earth science professionals.

stakeholders.name: Nigerian Society of Mining Engineers (NSME)
stakeholders.description: Professional body promoting technical excellence, safety and industry development.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Engineering standards, capacity building, professional accreditation.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Provides training, technical guidance and certification; supports engineering best practices; advises government.
stakeholders.mandate: Professional body promoting technical excellence, safety and industry development.

stakeholders.name: Council of Nigerian Mining Engineers and Geoscientists (COMEG)
stakeholders.description: Regulate and accredit mining and geoscience professionals in Nigeria.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Certifies and licenses professionals; enforces ethical and technical standards; accredits academic programmes.
stakeholders.mandate: Regulate and accredit mining and geoscience professionals in Nigeria.

stakeholders.name: Geological Society of Nigeria (GSN)
stakeholders.description: Professional society for geologists promoting earth science and resource development.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Research, geological capacity building, professional exchange.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Organises conferences; supports geological fieldwork; publishes research.
stakeholders.mandate: Professional society for geologists promoting earth science and resource development.

stakeholders.name: Nigerian Association of Hydrogeologists (NAH)
stakeholders.description: Professional body dedicated to hydrogeology and groundwater management.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Groundwater science, environmental monitoring, professional development.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Provides training; conducts groundwater studies; advises government on water resource management.
stakeholders.mandate: Professional body dedicated to hydrogeology and groundwater management.

stakeholders.name: Nigerian Association for Engineering Geology (NAEG)
stakeholders.description: Professional society for engineering geology and geotechnics.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Technical standards, geotechnical expertise, professional development.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Provides training and field workshops; advances engineering geology practice; supports infrastructure and mining projects.
stakeholders.mandate: Professional society for engineering geology and geotechnics.

stakeholders.name: Miners Association of Nigeria Youth Wing / Nigeria Youth in Mining
stakeholders.description: Youth-focused wing promoting youth participation and innovation in mining.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Mobilises youth; offers training; supports entrepreneurship and sector engagement.
stakeholders.mandate: Youth-focused wing promoting youth participation and innovation in mining.

stakeholders.name: The Nigerian Association of Chambers of Commerce, Industry, Mines and Agriculture
stakeholders.description: Umbrella organisation representing business interests including mining.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Engages government on economic policies; connects investors; promotes trade and mineral sector opportunities.
stakeholders.mandate: Umbrella organisation representing business interests including mining.

stakeholders.name: Nigerian Metallurgical Society (NMS)
stakeholders.description: Professional body for metallurgists promoting materials science and metallurgy research.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Promotes metallurgical research; supports steel and metals development; organises capacity-building programmes.
stakeholders.mandate: Professional body for metallurgists promoting materials science and metallurgy research.

stakeholders.name: Society of Exploration Geophysicists (SEG) Nigeria Chapter
stakeholders.description: Supports geophysics education, research and exploration applications.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Provides training; promotes innovation in exploration geoscience; connects academia and industry.
stakeholders.mandate: Supports geophysics education, research and exploration applications.

stakeholders.name: Society for Mining Metallurgy Exploration (SME) Africa/Nigeria
stakeholders.description: Supports mining engineering, metallurgy and global mining standards.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Delivers global-standard training; promotes best practices; links Nigerian professionals to global networks.
stakeholders.mandate: Supports mining engineering, metallurgy and global mining standards.

stakeholders.name: Nigerian Association for Engineering Geology and the Environment (NAEGE)-IAEG Nigeria Chapter
stakeholders.description: Promotes engineering geology and environmental geoscience.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Organises conferences; supports research; participates in global engineering geology initiatives.
stakeholders.mandate: Promotes engineering geology and environmental geoscience.

stakeholders.name: Geological Society of Africa (GSAf)
stakeholders.description: Pan-African society promoting Earth science across Africa.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Promotes African geoscience research; organises continental conferences; supports collaboration on minerals and geoscience.
stakeholders.mandate: Pan-African society promoting Earth science across Africa.

stakeholders.name: African Union African Minerals Development Centre (AMDC)
stakeholders.description: Supports AU states with policies on minerals governance, beneficiation and capacity building.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Provides technical assistance; supports reforms; promotes Africa’s mineral beneficiation agenda.
stakeholders.mandate: Supports AU states with policies on minerals governance, beneficiation and capacity building.

stakeholders.mandate: Collection of legal  dredging and mining operators in Lagos
